note: Syriac canon acquisitions, curated 2026-09-16 from ~/sourcelibrary-ops/handoffs/2026-09-16-syriac-acquisitions.md. Every identifier was checked on archive.org the same day: library scan (not a personal PDF upload) unless noted, not access-restricted, IIIF manifest present, imprint pre-1929. `lang` is the EDITION's principal language (invariants/language-fields.md); `languages` lists the substantial languages of a facing-text edition.

BOOKS.title: Chronique de Michel le Syrien, patriarche jacobite d'Antioche (1166-1199), tome I
BOOKS.author: Michael the Syrian
BOOKS.note: Chabot's French translation, vol. 1 of 4. Vol. 4 (the Syriac text) is chroniquedemiche04mich; vols. 2-3 have no image scan on archive.org (2026-09-16).

BOOKS.title: Chronique de Michel le Syrien, patriarche jacobite d'Antioche (1166-1199), tome IV: texte syriaque
BOOKS.author: Michael the Syrian
BOOKS.note: Chabot, vol. 4: facsimile of the Syriac text (Paris, Leroux, 1910). Largest medieval chronicle in any language.

BOOKS.title: Syrian Anatomy, Pathology and Therapeutics, or 'The Book of Medicines', vol. I: Syriac text
BOOKS.author: E. A. Wallis Budge (ed.)
BOOKS.note: Greek medicine, astrological prognostics and charms in one Syriac tradition.

BOOKS.title: Syrian Anatomy, Pathology and Therapeutics, or 'The Book of Medicines', vol. II: English translation
BOOKS.author: E. A. Wallis Budge (tr.)

BOOKS.title: Evangelion da-Mepharreshe: the Curetonian Version of the Four Gospels, with the readings of the Sinai Palimpsest, vol. I: Text
BOOKS.author: F. Crawford Burkitt (ed.)
BOOKS.note: Old Syriac Gospels, older than the Peshitta we hold; Syriac text with facing English.

BOOKS.title: Evangelion da-Mepharreshe: the Curetonian Version of the Four Gospels, vol. II: Introduction and Notes
BOOKS.author: F. Crawford Burkitt

BOOKS.title: The Old Syriac Gospels, or Evangelion da-Mepharreshê: the text of the Sinai palimpsest with the variants of the Curetonian text
BOOKS.author: Agnes Smith Lewis (ed.)
BOOKS.note: Sinaitic palimpsest text. Lewis's 1894 English translation is already held (translationoffo00lewi).

BOOKS.title: Codex Syro-Hexaplaris Ambrosianus photolithographice editus
BOOKS.author: Antonio Maria Ceriani (ed.)
BOOKS.note: Facsimile of the Milan Syro-Hexapla manuscript: how part of Origen's lost Hexapla survives.

BOOKS.title: The Chronicle of Joshua the Stylite, composed in Syriac A.D. 507
BOOKS.author: Joshua the Stylite
BOOKS.note: Wright's edition: Syriac text with English translation. Eyewitness of the 502-506 war and famine at Edessa.

BOOKS.title: Chronicon anonymi auctoris ad annum Christi 1234 pertinens, vol. I (CSCO 81)
BOOKS.author: Anonymous (ed. J.-B. Chabot)

BOOKS.title: Chronicon anonymi auctoris ad annum Christi 1234 pertinens, vol. II (CSCO 82)
BOOKS.author: Anonymous (ed. J.-B. Chabot)

BOOKS.title: The Syriac Chronicle known as that of Zachariah of Mitylene
BOOKS.author: Pseudo-Zachariah Rhetor

BOOKS.title: Historia ecclesiastica Zachariae Rhetori vulgo adscripta, vol. I: textus (CSCO 83)
BOOKS.author: Pseudo-Zachariah Rhetor (ed. E. W. Brooks)
BOOKS.note: Personal upload (no IA date/publisher; 131 images, likely two leaves per image) of Brooks's 1919 Syriac text volume. Text is pre-1929 and Brooks (d. 1955) is out of EU term since 2026; scan vintage unknown.

BOOKS.title: Historia ecclesiastica Zachariae Rhetori vulgo adscripta, vol. II: textus (CSCO 84)
BOOKS.author: Pseudo-Zachariah Rhetor (ed. E. W. Brooks)
BOOKS.note: Same upload family as Text1; 118 images.

BOOKS.title: Chronique de Denys de Tell-Mahré, quatrième partie
BOOKS.author: Pseudo-Dionysius of Tel-Mahre (Chronicle of Zuqnin)
BOOKS.note: Chabot 1895: Syriac text and French translation of part IV of the Zuqnin chronicle (the 8th-century eyewitness part). Parts I-III (CSCO 91/104, 1927/1933) not found on archive.org as image scans.

BOOKS.title: Sources syriaques, vol. I: Mshiha-Zkha (texte et traduction); Bar-Penkayé (texte)
BOOKS.author: Alphonse Mingana (ed.)
BOOKS.note: Contains John bar Penkaye's Rish Melle, book XV: among the earliest Syriac responses to the Arab conquest.

BOOKS.title: Lexicon syriacum auctore Hassano bar Bahlule, vol. I
BOOKS.author: Hassan bar Bahlul (ed. Rubens Duval)
BOOKS.note: 10th-century Syriac-Arabic lexicon: a working instrument for the translation lane, not only a reading text.

BOOKS.title: Lexicon syriacum auctore Hassano bar Bahlule, vol. II
BOOKS.author: Hassan bar Bahlul (ed. Rubens Duval)

BOOKS.title: Lexicon syriacum auctore Hassano bar Bahlule, vol. III
BOOKS.author: Hassan bar Bahlul (ed. Rubens Duval)

BOOKS.title: The Life of Rabban Hormizd and the Foundation of his Monastery at Al-Kosh: a metrical discourse by Wahle, surnamed Sergius of Adhorbaijan
BOOKS.author: Sergius of Adhorbaijan (ed. E. A. Wallis Budge)
BOOKS.note: Syriac text (Berlin, 1894). Budge's 1902 two-volume 'Histories of Rabban Hormizd' exists on archive.org only as personal PDF uploads (no image derivatives).

BOOKS.title: The Book of the Himyarites: fragments of a hitherto unknown Syriac work
BOOKS.author: Axel Moberg (ed.)
BOOKS.note: Lund 1924; Syriac text with English translation. Najran martyrs, 6th century.
